name: Pong (Rev E)
status: Component complement is complete and verified against Atari assembly drawing A001433 Rev E — all 66 ICs at their board grid positions, plus 34 discrete parts. The +5V and GND rails are wired and verified against each device's datasheet, including the three that break the usual TTL convention (7490/7493 on pins 5/10, 7483 on 5/12, 555 on 8/1). Signal nets are not yet traced from schematic 002826, so net highlighting covers the power rails only.
